correctness.rationale: Over the two-element field the exact adjacency symbol factors into three commuting binomials and a unit. The image of the first two is the \((m-1)(n-1)\)-dimensional row/column-even array space. Fixed points of simultaneous diagonal translation form a \(\gcd(m,n)\)-dimensional orbit-constant space; its intersection with row/column-even arrays is the single parity constraint \(\sum_r c_r=0\), of dimension \(\gcd(m,n)-1\), because the reduced periods are coprime. Rank-nullity proves the complete formula. The known Riera et al. Lemma 4.1 supplies the cited ancillary rule. Exact binary elimination for 529 period pairs and six edge orientations checks the critical algebraic identities but is not the source of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact number of commuting-extension ancillas is a natural resource question for translationally invariant six-neighbor mixed graph states. A closed formula valid for every rectangular toroidal period, including even dimensions, removes the need for large binary-rank computation and reveals a genuine winding-orbit gcd correction. The result concerns a fixed mathematically motivated network architecture, not an arbitrary parameter slice or trivial substitution.
